AVAILABLE FROM THE ANCHOR ROOMS BAR OR PALLIGHTPRO.CO.UK

g.data-flaw: The presenter line is set over THE ANCHOR ROOMS and the doors time is merged into the date, because the aligner moved the presenter to explain a band it could not otherwise.
g.data-outlook: Fixable: moving the presenter should cost more than a normal line, and a two-size date should stay two lines.
